Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing spouses of United States armed forces members who died while in service or as a result of service to apply for gold star license plates.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to gold star license plates; and amending RCW46.18.245.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 46.18.245 and 2010 c 161 s 621 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A registered owner who is the mother ((or)), father, or spouseof a member of the United States armed forces who died while in serviceto his or her country, or as a result of his or her service, may applyto the department for special gold star license plates for use on amotor vehicle. The registered owner must: (a) Be a resident of this state; (b) Provide certification from the Washington state department ofveterans affairs that the registered owner qualifies for the speciallicense plate under this section; (c) Be recorded as the registered owner of the motor vehicle onwhich the gold star license plates will be displayed; and (d) Pay all fees and taxes required by law for registering themotor vehicle. (2) Gold star license plates must be issued: p. 1 HB 1132 (a) Only for motor vehicles owned by qualifying applicants; and (b) Without payment of any license plate fee. (3) Gold star license plates must be replaced, free of charge, ifthe license plates become lost, stolen, damaged, defaced, or destroyed. (4) Gold star license plates may be transferred from one motorvehicle to another motor vehicle owned by the mother ((or)), father, orspouse, as described in subsection (1) of this section, uponapplication to the department, county auditor or other agent, orsubagent appointed by the director.
